The pages of the case study:

- [Background](../../cases/housing/index.qmd) – the original study, the robustness study, the five reanalyses and the replication.
- [Specification menu](../../cases/housing/menu.qmd) – the decisions of the analysis in three groups, with the options that the curve keeps and the reasons for the ones that it does not.
- [Decision map](../../cases/housing/menu.qmd#map) – every decision in the order in which an analyst meets it; selecting an option rewrites the estimand statement and shows the result.
- [Specification curve](../../cases/housing/curve.qmd) – the curve of `r nrow(curve)` specifications, with the published result, the five reanalyses and the replication placed on it.
- [Class results](../../cases/housing/class-results.qmd) – the live class chart.
